title: The Model T drive to Chicago
summary: The drive took a day or two, sleeping in the car and losing half a day to repairs after the generator burned out.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. Because we must just remember that we haven't really done New Orleans properly, so we'll go back to that later. Now we might as well go up to Chicago on this when you leave in the Model T Ford. And this tape is just about over so we'll take a break and start in Chicago. How long would it take you to drive up there then?
We stopped so much, you know, and --
I guess it must have been about --
About two days, a day or so.
Yeah, and didn't we -- and we didn't stop in any hotel, did we?
No.
We stayed right in the car, rested in the car.
Yeah. And we had this -- a thing blew out on my car.
Yeah.
And we had trouble getting that fixed.
Yeah, we had to spend almost a half a day.
And then I mean, in those days I guess you used to get punctures and --
Oh, yeah.
Yeah.
But I don't think we had any tire trouble at all.
No, no.
But we had this generator burn out.
Yeah, that's why it took us longer to get there.
Yeah.
But we were happy all through it, it didn't phase us at all, you know. And we didn't stop --
(End of proceedings as recorded.)
